notes: Overview: Fulcrum builds a real-time auction-based personalization engine for ecommerce marketplaces. Heavy reranking at checkout and search; extreme peak seasonality (holiday promos).
Primary ask: reserved capacity with hard throughput guarantees during defined peak windows (4 hours/day during promos) and a clear credit policy if throughput SLO missed.
Commit bands under consideration: 8 GPUs (min), 24 GPUs (baseline), 48 GPUs (peak). Prefer 12/24/48 split for pricing tiers. Want option to scale burst overlay at 1.5x for short windows.

Utilization scenarios requested by finance: conservative=40% utilization, baseline=65%, aggressive=85%. Need per-scenario unit cost per 1k tokens and per-request cost given average tokens/request = 1.2k tokens (rerank pipeline includes candidate embedding ops).

Model mix assumptions: 70% 32B int8 for highest quality rerank path, 20% 13B int8 as medium-quality fallback, 10% 7B quantized for extreme overloads. Routing policy should be modeled in cost spreadsheet.
Customer target: blended unit cost <= $0.0012 per 1k tokens at baseline utilization; finance will accept up to $0.0018 if SLA credits/pooled bursts included.

Requested deliverables from Redwood: 
      - GPU equivalence table (A100 80GB / L40 / A40 throughput mapping),

Requested deliverables from Redwood (cont): provide tokens/sec per model variant, prefix cache impact estimate (SE suggested 10-15% token reduction for top templates), and recommended commit discount tiers with burst pricing.

Perf notes from demo (2026-02-20): synthetic rerank load at 15k qps candidate calls produced p50=35ms, p95=180ms on 24 GPU dedicated test cluster using 32B int8; sustained throughput plateaued when KV cache misses increased.
Legal: wants explicit formula for throughput SLO credits: e.g., credit = max(0, (SLA_target - observed_throughput)/SLA_target) * monthly_commit_fee * credit_cap(30%).
Procurement feedback: prefer Annual commit with quarterly usage true-ups. If Redwood provides a 12-month price floor and burst overlay, Fulcrum will agree to 24-month term.
SE recommendation: enable model routing based on queue depth + >10% prefix caching for repeated session templates to improve effective utilization. Include that as a scenario in cost model.
AE note: propose 3 quotes: minimal (8 GPU, higher unit price, flexible term), standard (24 GPU, best unit price), heavy (48 GPU, deepest discount + reserved burst credits).
